text:
Type: white self-watering plant pot
Use: growing an indoor plant with less frequent watering, on a floor, shelf or windowsill; living room, kitchen, home office
Style: modern, minimalist, Scandinavian
Materials: matte white plastic, orange water-level indicator
Colors: white, orange accent
Shape: round tapered pot with a rolled rim, small orange water gauge at the edge, standing on small rounded feet, compact and clean
Feel: fresh, practical, playful, tidy
Goes with: green plants, white walls, light wood, bright accents; modern, Scandinavian or minimalist rooms

product.name: IKEA PS FEJ
product.description: Will help your plant to thrive, even if you can't water regularly.
